title: time cutoffs --strategy fanout against union on MGnify recruits
body: There is no usable cost model. nail's and mmseqs' runtimes do not scale linearly in target size, so estimating either arm by a per-comparison rate is wrong and any crossover derived that way is not to be trusted. Measured so far: fanout has a per-invocation floor of about 0.65 s seen on a four-family toy; the recruits come to 20,795 families, mean 5,427, max 221,046, 1.13e8 pairs, and the distinct-sequence count union scales with is not recorded. union is clearly right at SwissProt scale, where the pool caps near 570k; for MGnify it is unproven either way. --strategy auto stays unimplemented until this is measured; a rule of thumb is not a model.
close_reason: settled 6 Oct: one search per family for every tool. Pooled nail at fill's settings is the cross product (467 GB of prefilter in minutes) and the pooled judge did not finish a part in 2 min against 77 s for all families. Per-family fill over the 100 shards at -j 48: nail 30,346 cpu-s (median 1.14 s), mmseqs chain 28,428 (1.34), hmmsearch 7,804 (0.25), 24m02 wall, parent 719 MB; learn 1 s; 20,778 families, nail_1 median 23.0, mmseqs_1 34.0, hmmer_1 23.1. --strategy removed.

notes.author: jackroddy/21204bf1
notes.text: Measured on the 100 recruited shards in the sandbox (tmp-claude/2026-10-06-strategy-timing/): 11.2 M pairs, 10.4 M distinct sequences, 20,778 families. gather 50 s. Judge (hmmsearch over originals, -Z 2455940): fanout 77 s at -j 48; union killed after 2 min of its hmmsearch batch with no part finished, after a 46 s query split. hmmer is fanout at any scale, as expected: no index to amortise, so union is every family against the whole pool. nail and mmseqs fill being timed next.
